 Yancey Board of Elections Emergency Meeting
 November 9, 2026 
 The Yancey County Board of Election will hold an Emergency Meeting on November 10 th  , 2026 at 5:30 pm.  The purpose of the meeting is an evidentiary hearing on a challenged absentee by mail ballot that was fed through the Early Voting DS200 tabulator during the Early Voting period.
